utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Kira, did you hear about the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday? I think we should all pitch in!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? Who's organizing it, and do we know for sure it's happening this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Well, I heard it was Marcus from across the street getting it started, but I’m not sure if it’s totally confirmed yet—maybe we should check with him?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Noah, I'm thinking we should get everyone together for a repair drive this weekend. What do you think?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, a repair drive? That sounds... good? I think I might have plans, but I'm not sure. Let me check my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No problem, just let me know! I’ll start spreading the word to the rest of the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got the tools ready for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I just saw you loading some stuff into your truck. Looks like you're all set.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, just double-checking I didn't forget any spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, the repair drive... I heard a bit from Mr. Henson. He said it's brought in new tools, but I'm not sure what to make of it yet.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Well, I've seen a few crates being unloaded. Looked like welding gear and maybe some circuit parts.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Welding gear, huh? That sounds serious. I wonder if they're planning to fix up the old community center.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Jules, have you heard anything about when that repair drive is supposed to start? I need to plan around school drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I'm not sure yet, but I can ask around at the community board meeting tonight. Want me to text you when I find out?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That would be great, thanks! Just shoot me a text whenever you know—I’m usually free after 3 PM.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, I'm all for it as long as there's a clear schedule. Can't abide by surprises at my age.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, absolutely, Eli. A schedule sounds good—I'll have to write it down somewhere I won't lose it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that's sensible. I'll put it on my calendar too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Pia, have you heard about the repair drive happening this weekend? I'm helping spread the word—everyone's invited!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that sounds nice, but where exactly is it and what time? I want to make sure I can fit it into my schedule.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It's at the community center on Maple Street, starting at 10 AM on Saturday. You can drop by anytime!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that repair drive sounds like a big project—have you heard much about it from the folks around here?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s been the talk of the block! I’ve been collecting sign-ups all week, and everyone seems eager to lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s great to hear! I haven’t had a chance to chat with many neighbors yet, so I’m glad to know they’re all on board.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hmm, I'm not sure about the repair drive. Could you tell me more about what you've heard?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Honestly, I've heard a few different things, but I'm not certain of the details. Want to check with Mrs. Gable? She usually knows what's going on.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That's a good idea. Mrs. Gable is usually reliable with these things. Do you want to go ask her together?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll help where I can, but I'm just getting by.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Uli, sorry I'm late—did I miss the rundown on the repair drive? I can pitch in with whatever's needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No, you haven't missed it. I'm just... taking it slow today.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Need any tools for the repair drive? I've got a few I can lend out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you have a heavy-duty wrench? Mine broke last week, and I need one for the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ve got a solid one in the garage. Let me grab it for you.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, are you talking about the repair drive? I've been trying to keep track of where everyone's going.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I think folks are heading to different spots. I'm just trying to remember who's covering the hardware store run.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I recall someone mentioning they'd swing by the hardware store—was it Marcus? Or maybe Terrence?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Rey, I heard you're working on the repair drive. Need me to grab my tool kit?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Actually, yeah, that would be a big help. I'm stuck on the alignment.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, I'll be right back with it — those alignment issues can be tricky.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I just need to know: is the repair drive going to be well-organized, or is it going to be a free-for-all?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: How can you be sure it'll be well-organized?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Well, I can't be sure, but if nobody's coordinating, things could get messy fast.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara, how's the repair drive coming along? I've heard a lot of people are pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It's really picking up! Lots of folks are donating tools and time. I'm just hoping we can get everything sorted before the weather turns.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That's great to hear! If you need an extra hand coordinating between different groups, I'd be happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Dane, what kind of supplies are we looking for for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late, Cleo. What's the repair drive all about again?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It's a community effort to fix up old appliances and electronics folks have lying around. Just trying to gather any spare parts or tools people can spare.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Did you hear about the repair drive? They're fixing up the old community center down the block.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, that's wonderful news! My kids have been asking when they can go back for their afterschool programs.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I know! I heard they're even adding a new computer lab for the teenagers — my nephew is thrilled about that.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Rosa, what's this about a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh hi Bo! We're organizing a neighborhood repair drive this Saturday to fix up shared tools and broken items. Would you like to lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Saturday, huh? I might be free in the afternoon—what kind of stuff needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Leo, how's the repair drive going? Need any help?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Going fine. Got the tools ready, but could use an extra hand lifting that old generator.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, I’ll grab the other end. Where do you want it moved?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Nell, you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We're all pitching in to fix up the community garden shed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, is that coming up? I hadn't heard the details yet—tell me more about it!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Well, we're meeting at 9 AM by the shed, and everyone's bringing tools or snacks. I'm spreading the word to make sure we get a good turnout!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I saw the repair drive truck headed down Oak Street about an hour ago. Did you catch where they stopped?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, I was out tending my roses around that time, so I didn't get a good look. Wish I had a clearer view.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Maybe we can keep an eye out later. I'll let you know if I spot it again.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Hana, did you sign up for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven't yet—could you remind me what time it starts on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It starts at 9 AM on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Oren, I heard you're organizing a repair drive — got any fliers I can hand out at the market?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the fliers! I think I left them on the kitchen counter... or was it the car? Let me check.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No rush, I'll grab a few when you find them. I'm heading to the market anyway.
